0.content: Shinsuke's daughter secretly wrote to the Traveler, arranged an escort ruse for a shipment and had them carry a letter to Kujou Kamaji. She says her father has always spoiled her. After his arrest she became acting head of the clan and, per the wiki, took a more serious stance once a false wedding letter plot was foiled.

1.content:
In Ritou Escape Plan the Traveler needs a travel permit to cross to Narukami Island. Shinsuke asks for 300 fresh Qingxin, then for 709 letters delivered, and the Traveler says only that they will consider it. A woman behind him nods; a bodyguard delivers a perfumed letter from his daughter; Chisato explains the ploy and the Traveler escorts a transport balloon out of Ritou as her guard, with Shinnojou and Kenzaburou on watch.

The quest also unlocks the Sacred Sakura's Favor offering system and a follow-up world quest, Chisato's Letter.

2.comment: Hiiragi Shinsuke: Crystal Marrow and the Fatui scheme
2.content: Crystal Marrow, a local specialty holding a sliver of Tatarigami power, was used in making Delusions. According to the Inazuma International Trade Association's president Kurisu, the Kanjou Commission decreed that merchants pay taxes in Marrow and then resold it at a higher price. The wiki ties this to the Fatui scheme in which Shinsuke took part.
